answer: Histories are stored in horizon, checked in falcon, and inlet publishes each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 17 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 3954 identities would post 4997 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
